items.originalTitle: Colton Herta eyes potential Indy 500 return and IMSA enduros as 2027 plans remain in flux
detailZh: 科顿·赫塔展望2027年可能重返印第安纳波利斯500赛事和IMSA耐力赛，但计划仍处于变动之中
超级执照的追求是首要任务，但这位加州本土车手明确表示，如果日程允许，他不会拒绝印第安纳波利斯500的席位或IMSA耐力赛的驾驶机会
科顿·赫塔的2027年赛车计划尚未确定，但这位凯迪拉克一级方程式测试车手渴望在日程允许的情况下重返印第安纳波利斯500和IMSA耐力赛。这位26岁的加州本土车手，目前正在Hitech车队完成他在FIA二级方程式锦标赛的首个赛季，尚未确定明年的计划
随着他的职业道路聚焦于获得一级方程式所需的FIA超级执照，赫塔即将到来的承诺将决定他是否能够重返美国主要赛车赛事的阵容，包括‘500’和IMSA WeatherTech体育车手锦标赛的耐力赛轮次。
赫塔，在IndyCar系列赛中赢得了九场比赛，并在2024年获得了亚军，从2019年到2025年连续参加了七届印第安纳波利斯500赛事，原计划在今年5月驾驶安德里蒂全球车队的一辆赛车，但由于FIA在蒙特利尔增加了一站Formula 2赛事，以取代巴林和沙特阿拉伯取消的比赛，导致日程安排发生重大变动，这让他感到非常痛苦。
回顾这次错失的机会以及他对“赛车界最伟大的盛事”的渴望，赫塔明确表示，如果他的日程允许，他将在2027年参赛。
“是的，我永远不会拒绝参加印第安纳波利斯500，”赫塔对Motorsport.com说。“我总是想参加印第安纳波利斯500。今年没能参加真是太遗憾了。你知道，一切都已经安排好了。”
当被问及这个破坏性的日程变动如何打乱了他的5月计划时，他补充说：“是的，这打乱了所有计划。但这是不可避免的，不幸的是，它没有发生。我不知道我明年的情况会怎样。但如果我有机会，100%我会想参加印第安纳波利斯500。”
#40 凯迪拉克 Wayne Taylor Racing 凯迪拉克 V-Series.R：乔丹·泰勒，路易斯·德莱特拉斯，科尔顿·赫塔
赫塔目前在F2积分榜上排名第19位，本赛季最佳成绩是在巴塞罗那短道赛中获得第五名，此外还有四次进入前八名。当前的F2赛历以连续两轮在卡塔尔（11月28日至29日）和阿布扎比（12月5日至6日）结束，尽管这些赛事在中东地区2月份开始的地区冲突中已经面临了几个月的不确定性。
除了单座赛车外，赫塔本赛季还作为Wayne Taylor Racing耐力车队的成员，在#40凯迪拉克车上参与了赛车运动，并在Petit Le Mans赛事中获得了领奖台的成绩。他明年能否继续在主要的发展任务之外平衡赛车出场的可能性尚未确定。
“如果由我来决定，我会尽可能多地尝试……尽可能多地参加三项耐力赛事（戴通纳24小时耐力赛、摩比1十二小时赛布林格和Petit Le Mans），”赫塔关于他的赛车前景说道。
“我真的很喜欢这个……我看了所有的比赛，所以我不错过这些人的任何一场比赛。成为其中一员很有趣，但如果由我来决定，我会百分之百尝试回到比赛中。但是，你知道，我认为这完全取决于明年会是什么样子，而这，我还不清楚。”
detailEn: Colton Herta eyes potential Indy 500 return and IMSA enduros as 2027 plans remain in flux
Super License pursuits take priority, but the California native makes clear he won't turn down an Indy 500 seat or IMSA endurance drives if calendar space opens up

Colton Herta’s 2027 racing plans remain undecided, but the Cadillac Formula 1 test driver is eager to return to both the Indianapolis 500 and IMSA endurance races if his schedule allows. The 26-year-old California native, currently completing his debut campaign in the FIA Formula 2 Championship with Hitech, has yet to finalize his program for next year.

With his career path focused on securing the FIA Super License required for Formula 1, Herta's upcoming commitment will dictate whether he can rejoin the grid for America's major motorsports events, including the '500' and the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship endurance rounds.

Herta, who amassed nine wins in his IndyCar Series career and finished as championship runner-up in 2024, made seven consecutive starts in the Indianapolis 500 from 2019 through 2025,  He was slated to pilot a fourth entry for Andretti Global this past May, but a late calendar upheaval – prompted by the FIA adding a Formula 2 round in Montreal alongside the Formula 1 Canadian Grand Prix to replace canceled events in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia – forced a heartbreaking conflict.
Reflecting on the missed opportunity and his appetite for “The Greatest Spectacle in Racing,” Herta left no ambiguity about his intentions if his calendar permits in 2027.
“Yeah, I’ll never turn down the Indy 500,” Herta told Motorsport.com. “I always want to do the Indy 500. It was a shame this year that I couldn't do it. You know, it was all set up.”

Asked about the disruptive late schedule change that derailed his May plans, he added: “Yes, and that threw everything out. But it was going to happen and unfortunately it didn’t. I don’t know what next year looks like for me. But if I get the chance, 100 percent, I would love to do the Indy 500.”
#40 Cadillac Wayne Taylor Racing Cadillac V-Series.R: Jordan Taylor, Louis Deletraz, Colton Herta

Herta currently sits 19th in the F2 standings, with a season-best finish of fifth in the Barcelona Sprint Race alongside four additional top-eight results. The current F2 calendar concludes with back-to-back rounds in Qatar (November 28–29) and Abu Dhabi (December 5–6), though those events have faced months of uncertainty amid regional conflicts in the Middle East that began in February.

Beyond single-seaters, Herta has embedded himself in sports car racing this season as part of Wayne Taylor Racing’s endurance lineup in the #40 Cadillac, and is fresh off a podium result at Petit Le Mans. Whether he can continue balancing sports car appearances alongside his primary development duties next year remains undecided.

“If it was up to me, I would try to do as much as possible… as much as possible doing the three endurance races (Rolex 24 At Daytona, Mobil 1 Twelve Hours of Sebring, and Petit Le Mans),” Herta said regarding his sports car prospects.

“I really enjoy that... I watch all the races, so I don't miss a race from these guys. It's a lot of fun to be a part of it, but if it's up to me, 100 percent I will try to be back in doing races. But, you know, I think it all depends on what next year looks like, which I just, I don't know yet.”

items.summaryZh: 在F1宣布与非洲签订长达十年的赛事协议后，一位粉丝在72小时内利用Assetto Corsa模拟器重现了卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道。

media.altZh: F1粉丝在"Assetto Corsa"模拟器中重现卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: F1 fan brings Rwanda's future grand prix circuit to life in "Assetto Corsa" simulation
detailZh: F1粉丝在"Assetto Corsa"模拟器中重现卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道
一位粉丝在F1宣布与非洲签订长达十年的赛事协议后，仅用72小时就在Assetto Corsa模拟器中重现了卢旺达的拟议F1赛道。
Motorsport文化超越赛道本身。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车运动不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
在F1宣布与非洲签订长达十年的赛事协议后，一位用户制作的赛道内摄像头记录的视频开始在网络上流传，展示了卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道的场景。
这是从驾驶舱内对赛道感受的有趣一瞥，但它只是基于F1迄今为止发布的单一预览图像的业余爱好者的最佳猜测，并非真实布局。所以请记住这一点。
修改者名为Nukedrop，西班牙F1账号Nachez在X上发布了这段视频。屏幕录制视频获得了大约695个赞，吸引了41,000名观众，最初在Reddit的Formula1版块出现。
Nukedrop在YouTube的描述中提到，这个修改是在“过去24小时左右”内创建的。他通过将F1渲染背景中的机场与卫星图像匹配来放置赛道，然后使用了周围景观的真实海拔数据。这个模拟使用了一辆涂有当前红白车身的法拉利，车号为44 - 汉密尔顿的赛车 - 七届冠军的黄色头盔在屏幕底部刚刚露出，它在桥下穿行并跨越了多彩的赛道边缘。
Tyrone Hesbrook以Nukedrop的别名在Assetto Corsa社区中确立了自己作为一位杰出的赛道创作者的地位，他之前的作品包括派克峰和独立设计的赛道，如Circuit Thermalito。
不要把它与其他粉丝的努力混淆。Romeo Gagliotti的“Rwanda International Circuit”模组是一个虚构的5.3公里顺时针布局，TC Esports在F1 25游戏中发布了非官方版本。
Nukedrop的赛道长度仅为4.65公里——比官方设计师描述的大约6公里布局短了1.35公里。官方赛道将有17个弯道，并逆时针行驶。完整的布局尚未公布，Nukedrop承认他的版本涉及“大量关于比例、海拔和隐藏细节的推测”。
海拔甚至更难以理解。Wurz计算出的圈数为197米的垂直海拔上升，而粉丝制作的版本在整个赛道上大约有70米的海拔变化。这些不是相同的测量，所以两者都可以是正确的：赛道可以总共上升197米，但底部到顶部的跨度只有70米。
WurzDesign与Tilke Engineering合作，在基加利以南大约40公里的Bugesera开发赛道，靠近一个预计将于2028年开放的机场。赛道蜿蜒穿过高地地形，穿过湖边区域，拥有倾斜的弯道，并包含一条超过1公里的高速直道，直道将在一个旨在促进超车的紧弯道结束。
车臣·蒂尔克表示，坡度达到12-13%，而沃兹将结果称为“像过山车一样，真正独特”。
沃兹已经通过模拟完成了无数圈，而且虚拟赛道也由活跃的一级方程式车手进行了测试。这与一个基于新闻渲染图的修改者进行的研究标准略有不同，尽管粉丝版本先到，Nukedrop的Patreon支持者已经可以下载了。
由于第一场比赛要到2030年代初才举行，我们将猜测多年。在完整布局发布之前，Assetto Corsa中的法拉利将是大多数我们能接触到的最接近的东西。
detailEn: F1 fan brings Rwanda's future grand prix circuit to life in "Assetto Corsa" simulation
A fan has recreated Rwanda's proposed Formula 1 circuit in Assetto Corsa just days after the historic grand prix announcement
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Within 72 hours of Formula 1 revealing a decade-long deal to race in Africa, footage from a user-created onboard camera recording of Rwanda’s future grand prix venue began circulating online.

It’s a fun look at what the track could feel like from the cockpit, but it’s a hobbyist’s best guess created from the single preview image F1 has released so far, not the real layout. So bear that in mind.

The modder is Nukedrop, and Spanish F1 account Nachez spread the clip on X. The screen recording accumulated approximately 695 likes and reached 41,000 viewers, having initially surfaced in the Formula1 section of Reddit.

The mod, created within the Assetto Corsa game, was built in “the last 24 or so hours”, according to Nukedrop’s YouTube description. He placed the circuit by matching the airport in the background of F1’s render to satellite imagery, then used real elevation data for the surrounding landscape. The simulation uses a Ferrari bearing its current red-and-white livery and the number 44 - Hamilton’s car - with the seven-time champion’s yellow helmet just poking out at the bottom of the screen as it navigates beneath a bridge and across multi-hued track kerbing.

Tyrone Hesbrook, using the Nukedrop alias, has established himself as a prominent circuit creator in the Assetto Corsa community, with previous work spanning Pikes Peak and independently designed tracks including Circuit Thermalito.

Don’t confuse it with the other fan efforts. Romeo Gagliotti’s “Rwanda International Circuit” mod is a fictional 5.3km clockwise layout, and TC Esports has posted an unofficial version in the F1 25 game.

Nukedrop’s track measures just 4.65km - about 1.35km short of the roughly 6km layout the official designers describe. The official circuit will have 17 corners and run anti-clockwise. The full layout is yet to be published, and Nukedrop admits his version involves “plenty of educated guesses about scale, elevation and details hidden from view”.

Elevation is even trickier to understand. Wurz has calculated the lap to involve 197m of vertical elevation gain, whereas the fan-built version accounts for roughly 70m of altitude variation across the circuit. Those aren’t the same measurement, so both can be right: a track can climb 197m in total yet only span 70m from bottom to top.

WurzDesign, collaborating with Tilke Engineering, is developing the circuit in Bugesera, roughly 40km south of Kigali near an airport that is due to open in 2028. The track weaves through elevated terrain, runs through a lakeside section, features cambered corners, and contains a high-speed straight exceeding 1km that will end in a tight corner meant to facilitate passing.
Carsten Tilke says gradients reach 12-13%, and Wurz calls the result “like a roller coaster and truly unique”.

Wurz has completed numerous laps through simulation, and the virtual layout has been tested by active F1 drivers as well. That’s a slightly different standard of research from a modder working off a press render, though the fan version arrived first, and Nukedrop’s Patreon supporters can already download it.
With the first race not due until the early 2030s, we’ll be speculating for years. Until the full layout is released, a Ferrari in Assetto Corsa is as close as most of us will get.
keyPointsZh: 这是基于F1发布的唯一预览图像制作的模拟
重现的赛道视频已在网络上流传
keyPointsEn: The simulation is based on the single preview image released by F1
